assistantMode.title: Store assistant
assistantMode.subtitle: Per-store rollout. Off by default; only a super admin can change it.
assistantMode.loadFailed: Could not load the assistant mode.
assistantMode.confirmTitle: Turn the assistant on for this store?
assistantMode.confirmBody: This store's team will get the assistant in mode "{mode}".
assistantMode.saveFailed: Could not save the mode. Nothing was changed.

off.label: Off
off.meaning: The assistant is hidden and never runs for this store.

answer-only.label: Answer only
answer-only.meaning: It answers questions and explains screens. It never changes anything in the store.

suggest.label: Suggest
suggest.meaning: It can prepare changes as a preview, but nothing is applied unless the merchant confirms.

act.label: Act
act.meaning: The merchant can apply changes with one press; sensitive ones still need their confirmation.

assistantMode.effectiveOff: The store does not see the assistant right now: {reason}
assistantMode.effectiveCapped: The store sees the assistant in "{mode}" mode only (lower than saved).

reasons.global_kill: The assistant is stopped platform-wide (kill switch).
reasons.product_kill: The Store assistant is stopped platform-wide.
reasons.platform_cap_off: The platform-wide cap is still "off". Open it in platform settings.
reasons.store_ai_off: The merchant turned AI features off for their store.
reasons.store_mode_off: The store's own mode is off.
reasons.unreadable: We could not read the assistant settings, so it is off for now.
